Where the line sits

Update what’s there.
Scope what’s new.

Your plan confirms the allowance. These examples show how small content changes differ from new project work.

Within an agreed allowance

Everyday updates

  • Replace supplied text on an existing page
  • Update opening hours or contact details
  • Swap an approved image or document
  • Refresh an existing service description
Separate scope and approval

New work

  • Add pages or a product showcase
  • Redesign layouts or move platforms
  • Connect a new booking or enquiry tool
  • Reorganise the site’s navigation

New features, redesigns, marketing work and third-party charges are outside the content allowance. Emergency or out-of-hours support is not included unless separately agreed.

Care in practice

Small jobs.
A clear way through.

Requests follow an agreed route, so you know what is being changed and what needs a separate decision.

Send the request

Share the page, the approved content and what needs changing through the agreed support channel.

Confirm & update

We check the request against your scope. Extra work is quoted for approval before it begins.

Check & record

The agreed change is checked and recorded, with allowance used and any outstanding issues made clear.

Part of the agreement

Know who handles
the important things.

Care starts with a review of the website and the cover already provided by your host.

Maintenance, backups & monitoring

The plan specifies the tasks and their cadence, what is backed up, who provides the backups, frequency, retention and the restore process. Restore checks and monitoring are included only where agreed, with responsibility for checks, alerts and escalation identified.

Content requests & additional work

We agree the task or time allowance, request limits, whether unused allowance carries forward and how extra work is approved. Care does not include unlimited changes.

Support & incidents

We agree a channel, working hours and response targets. A response is acknowledgement and assessment, not a guaranteed fix. Resolution may depend on the issue and other providers. Round-the-clock support is not included.

Costs, ownership & leaving the plan

The care fee is separate from domains, hosting, licences and external tools. The agreement records ownership, renewals, billing, cancellation notice, access handover and remaining work when the plan ends.

A couple more questions

Before you choose.

Do I have to take a care plan?

No. We explain the maintenance and ownership responsibilities at handover so you can choose how to manage them.

Can you care for a website you didn’t build?

Potentially. We review the platform, condition, access and existing responsibilities before confirming suitability and scope.
